about: The reference board (docs/ART.md is the bar it measures against): the probe's views from ci/scene.sh, each beside the reference frames ART.md measured, and the operator's marks. The reference set is the reference game's screenshots, so it never enters this repo: point GATES_REFERENCE_DIR at your own copy, as for ci/native_bar.py. node ci/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; it scores nothing.
